'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Internal Conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
***A gunfight between militias and [[Myanmar]]'s security forces result in the death of 20 people. The fight erupted after the militias called for an armed resistance against the military regime. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/11/deadly-unrest-in-myanmar-as-opposition-urges-defensive (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Gay bishops|LGBTQ bishops]]
**The [[Sierra Pacific Synod]] of the [[Evangelical Lutheran Church in America]] (ELCA) installs the Rev. Dr. [[Megan Rohrer]] as [[Bishop]]. They are the first [[coming out|openly]] [[transgender]] and [[non-binary]] Bishop in any major [[Christian denomination]]. [https://www.advocate.com/transgender/2021/9/10/first-out-trans-bishop-installed-lutheran-denomination (The Advocate)] [https://www.npr.org/2021/09/11/1036371531/evangelical-lutheran-church-first-transgender-bishop-megan-rohrer (NPR)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] receives the first batch consisting of 500,000 doses of the [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine]] donated by the [[Netherlands]]. [https://jakartaglobe.id/news/indonesia-receives-janssen-vaccine-from-the-netherlands-and-first-delivery-from-frances-dosesharing (Jakarta Globe)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 592 deaths from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, including 492 backlogged deaths, bringing the nationwide death toll to 20,419. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2021/09/12/covid-19-record-number-of-covid-19-deaths-recorded-on-saturday-sept-11 (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record 26,303 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.206 million. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/09/11/21/new-covid-cases-in-ph-hit-record-single-day-high-26303 (ABS-CBN News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in South Africa]]
****The [[South African Health Products Regulatory Authority]] approves the usage of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children over the age of 12. [https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/south-africa/2021-09-11-saphra-approves-pfizer-covid-19-shot-for-children-12-and-up/ (Sowetan Live)]
***The number of confirmed COVID-19 cases in [[Africa]] surpasses eight million. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/africas-virus-tally-tops-8m-as-vaccine-crunch-bites/2362193 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] surpasses 60 million doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] administered, with 28.6 million [[Argentines]] having received one dose and 17.7 million being fully [[vaccinate]]d. [https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202109/568177-campana-vacunacion-coronavirus-argentina-llegada-astrazeneca.html (Télam)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Australia]] reports a record 2,070 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, including 1,599 new cases in [[New South Wales]]. It is the first time that the country has reported more than 2,000 cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://thewest.com.au/news/coronavirus/australia-sets-coronavirus-case-record-c-3932268 (''The West Australian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Moldova]]
***[[Moldova]] restricts the entry of restaurants, bars, and cultural events to people who have been [[COVID-19 vaccination in Moldova|vaccinated]] against COVID-19 until October 31 due to a sharp rise in COVID-19 cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldova-tightens-covid-19-curbs-amid-rise-infections-2021-09-09/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]], [[Alleged Saudi role in the September 11 attacks]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] releases its first document of the [[September 11 attacks]] and allegations of [[Saudi Arabia]] support for the hijackers following an executive order [[List of executive actions by Joe Biden|signed]] by [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/fbi-releases-first-911-document-after-biden-order-cnn-2021-09-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[China–Vietnam relations]]
**Chinese Foreign Minister [[Wang Yi (politician)|Wang Yi]] tells [[government of Vietnam|Vietnamese]] Deputy Prime Minister [[Phạm Bình Minh]] that both countries should refrain from unilateral actions regarding the [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea|South China Sea disputes]] that could complicate the situation and magnify the dispute. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/11/chinas-wang-yi-tells-vietnam-to-avoid-magnifying-sea-dispute (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A knifeman stabs and wounds two bus controllers in [[Rimini]], [[Italy]]. After exiting the bus, he [[mass stabbing|stabbed and wounded]] three passersby, including a 6-year-old child who is in a critical condition, before being arrested. Authorities ruled out [[terrorism]] as a possible motive behind the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/five-people-stabbed-italian-resort-somali-man-arrested-2021-09-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship]]
**In [[Gaelic football]], [[Tyrone county football team|Tyrone]] defeats [[Mayo county football team|Mayo]] in the [[2021 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship Final]] at [[Croke Park]] in [[Dublin]]. In doing so, Tyrone wins a fourth title and denies Mayo their first title since 1951. [https://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/2021/0911/1246025-all-ireland-sfc-final-mayo-v-tyrone-updates/ (RTE)]
**[[Conor McKenna]], who set up one of Tyrone's goals, becomes the fourth former [[Australian Football League|AFL]] player with an All-Ireland medal. [https://extra.ie/2021/09/11/sport/gaa/conor-mckenna-history (Extra.ie)]
*[[2021 US Open (tennis)|2021 US Open]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Emma Raducanu]] of [[Great Britain]] defeats [[Leylah Fernandez]] of [[Canada]], 6–4, 6–3, in the final of the [[2021 US Open – Women's Singles|women's singles]] to become the first [[Glossary of tennis terms#Q|qualifier]] to win a [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] title. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/sport/tennis-raducanu-beats-fernandez-win-us-open-2171896 (CNA)]

'''Religion and politics'''
*[[2021 Dismantling Global Hindutva Conference]]
**The 2021 Dismantling Global Hindutva conference, or the DGH, held between 10-12 September, apparently started out as a small group of academics planning a modest gathering to explore the dangers of Hindutva ideology. [https://theprint.in/opinion/the-gains-of-dismantling-global-hindutva-conference-will-help-reclaim-hinduism/735312/] [https://dismantlinghindutva.com/]
